subtitle: 랏힐 사정하더니 피치증 템은 다 딜러 거라는 파티

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
랏힐! 힐러님 제발 와줘요!
님 없으면 출발 못 해요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle comedic dungeon entrance shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, desperate Orc Warrior protection tank (1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield resting beside her on the stone) drops onto both knees clasping her empty hands pleading with huge teary sparkling crimson eyes. On the right, tired Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, gold crescent tiara, zero angel halo or wings, gold cross staff stowed on back) sighs reluctantly holding a small plain wooden wand at her side as she agrees to join.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
지능에 치유량 30 붙었네!
드디어 힐템 먹는다, 입찰!

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 마법 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 최대 30만큼 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
필드서 법봉질만 하다 왔는데
치유 템도 다 딜러 거냐?
